open_points.subject: execute_function descriptor inheritance
open_points.text: Every descriptor the environment needs from the parent — the write end of the trap channel, the --info-fd pipe — reaches bubblewrap by inheritance, passed with subprocess pass_fds, and bubblewrap keeps it open for the child
open_points.other_text: bubblewrap has no option that names a descriptor to keep, and --preserve-fds does not exist.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must bubblewrap preserve the trap-channel descriptor for the child using its descriptor-preservation option, or is the child not required to inherit it?
